get.description: Days of the month with day types, Danish public holidays and notable days.
An empty project for `month`, with every setting at its default.
A fictional demo team (9 people) with some availability and wishes.

post.description: Upgrade a saved project (any schema version) to the current version and validate it.
Generate a plan for the project's month. Blocks for up to the configured time limit.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: Error with a translatable message key; the frontend renders `code` with `params`.

BreakRule.title: BreakRule
BreakRule.description: A shift longer than `after_hours` includes a break of `minutes`.

BusRule-Input.title: BusRule
BusRule-Input.description: People who need a ride must start (or end) at exactly the same time as a driver.

BusRule-Output.title: BusRule
BusRule-Output.description: People who need a ride must start (or end) at exactly the same time as a driver.

DateRangePattern-Input.title: DateRangePattern
DateRangePattern-Input.description: Whole days from `start_date` to `end_date`, inclusive (e.g. vacation).

DateRangePattern-Output.title: DateRangePattern
DateRangePattern-Output.description: Whole days from `start_date` to `end_date`, inclusive (e.g. vacation).

DayHours-Input.title: DayHours
DayHours-Input.description: Opening hours for one day. Times are when the store is open to customers.

DayHours-Output.title: DayHours
DayHours-Output.description: Opening hours for one day. Times are when the store is open to customers.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
Diagnostic.description: A pre-check finding, explained in plain language (translated by the frontend).

EmployeeRuleOverrides-Input.title: EmployeeRuleOverrides
EmployeeRuleOverrides-Input.description: Per-employee replacements for global limits. `None` means "use the global rule".

EmployeeRuleOverrides-Output.title: EmployeeRuleOverrides
EmployeeRuleOverrides-Output.description: Per-employee replacements for global limits. `None` means "use the global rule".

GuestDemand-Input.title: GuestDemand
GuestDemand-Input.description: Optional: derive each day's required total staff hours from expected guests.

GuestDemand-Output.title: GuestDemand
GuestDemand-Output.description: Optional: derive each day's required total staff hours from expected guests.

HourBalance-Input.title: HourBalance
HourBalance-Input.description: Hours carried in from earlier months. The app doesn't remember past months.

HourBalance-Output.title: HourBalance
HourBalance-Output.description: Hours carried in from earlier months. The app doesn't remember past months.

ObjectiveWeights-Input.title: ObjectiveWeights
ObjectiveWeights-Input.description: Relative importance of the soft goals. Higher = matters more.

ObjectiveWeights-Output.title: ObjectiveWeights
ObjectiveWeights-Output.description: Relative importance of the soft goals. Higher = matters more.

SpecialDate-Input.title: SpecialDate
SpecialDate-Input.description: Custom opening hours (or closed) for one date. Only applies while `enabled`.

SpecialDate-Output.title: SpecialDate
SpecialDate-Output.description: Custom opening hours (or closed) for one date. Only applies while `enabled`.

Violation.title: Violation
Violation.description: A broken rule. The frontend translates `violation.<rule>` with `params`.

WeeklyPattern-Input.description: Every week on `weekday`, optionally only within a time window.

WeeklyPattern-Output.title: WeeklyPattern
WeeklyPattern-Output.description: Every week on `weekday`, optionally only within a time window.
